newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AVI plans 1996/97 real earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: AVI plans 1996/97 real earnings growth.

text.p: Anglovaal Industries Ltd (AVI) planned an improvement in real earnings in the year to end-June 1997 weathering difficult trading conditions, the company said on Wednesday.

Announcing results for the year to June 30, AVI said lower than expected economic activity, a decline in consumer spending, increased international competition and illegal imports, which had dampened earnings growth in the past year, still persisted.
These testing conditions would "present a tremendous challenge to the managements of all the group's operations", AVI said in a statement.
"To address these challenges, the companies within AVI are engaged in numerous initiatives aimed at increasing international competitiveness," the company said.
These included structural renewal and major capital expenditure programmes with an investment of 2.4 billion rand planned over the next three years.
AVI on Wednesday reported annual earnings before exceptional items up four percent to 161.3 cents a share. A dividend of 30 cents was declared compared to 28 cents a year ago.
